product.description: M.2 NVMe SSD external case for turning a spare or upgraded NVMe drive into a portable external drive. Fit your own NVMe SSD, plug it into a USB port and use it for backups, file transfers or extra storage. The SSD is not included. KES 1,500. Not sure your drive is NVMe? Send us the SSD model and we will confirm before you order.
compatible_models: Laptops and desktops with a free USB port

faqs.question: Is the SSD included?
faqs.answer: No. This is the case only. You fit your own M.2 NVMe SSD inside it.

faqs.question: Will it work with my SSD?
faqs.answer: This case is for M.2 NVMe SSDs. It is not for SATA M.2 SSDs. If you are unsure which type your drive is, send us the SSD model or a photo of its label on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Will it work with my laptop?
faqs.answer: It connects through USB, so it works with laptops and desktops that have a free USB port. If your laptop only has USB Type-C ports, it connects directly. If it only has the older rectangular USB-A ports, you will need a Type-C to USB-A cable or adapter.
